summary_en: The study tests REC-1245, a drug taken by mouth, in people with unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic cancer, including certain relapsed or refractory lymphomas. REC-1245 is taken by mouth once a day, and the length of treatment is not stated. The study measures safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, its effects on the body, and early activity against cancer; it is a Phase 1/2 study.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa REC-1245, un medicamento por vía oral, en personas con cáncer no resecable, localmente avanzado o metastásico, incluidos ciertos linfomas recidivantes o refractarios. REC-1245 se toma por vía oral una vez al día, y la duración del tratamiento no se indica. El estudio mide la seguridad, la tolerancia, cómo el cuerpo procesa el medicamento, sus efectos en el organismo y la actividad temprana contra el cáncer; es un estudio de fase 1/2.
who_for: Has histologically confirmed unresectable, locally advanced, or metastatic select solid tumor or select relapsed or refractory lymphoma
Has progressed, relapsed, or was intolerant to at least one standard systemic cancer treatment, or was considered ineligible for standard therapy
ECOG performance status of 1 or lower; adolescents need a Lansky or Karnofsky score of 70 or higher
Has measurable disease at baseline on CT and/or MRI per RECIST 1.1 or Lugano criteria
not_for: Received treatment with another RBM39 degrader
Has clinically significant gastrointestinal disease or gastrointestinal malabsorption
